blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Coach Jimmy Alapag made his feelings known after a rough first-half showing by NLEX in its 147-115 victory over Titan Ultra in the 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup on Wednesday at Ninoy Aquino Stadium. A moment early in the contest encapsulated Alapag’s frustrations when the game’s broadcast caught him telling the Road Warriors to play as if something big was at stake against a lowly Giant Risers side. “Don’t play with the game,” Alapag repeatedly told his players while also shaking his head in disappointment during a timeout huddle midway in the first quarter and Titan leading 14-12. “Come out, take […]...
